scope: All locked packages; no OS or architecture filter and no ignored advisories. Offline repeat uses the RustSec database fetched earlier in this validation session. Vendored changes require separate source review.
limitations: This checks known RustSec advisories, not the absence of undiscovered vulnerabilities.
Registry integrity and bundled SQLite patch status are checked separately.
The final release artifact must retain this Cargo.lock or repeat the audit.
